records.quote: From the binary peritectic decomposition, L + HfC1-x ↔ ␣Hf(C) at 2360 °C, ␣(Hf,Zr)(C) projects itself into the ternary partaking in a four-phase reaction at 2030 °C: ␣(Hf,Zr)(C) + L ↔ ␤(Hf,Zr)(C) + (Hf,Zr)C 1-x .
